     * <p>
     * This is a convenience method for unit testing.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rows     Number of rows.
     * @param cols     Number of columns.
     * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
     * @return A map with the cells set from {@code cellsRep}.
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the map is incorrectly formatted.
     */
    @NotNull
    static Map fromString(int rows, int cols, @NotNull String cellsRep) {
        var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);
        return new Map(rows, cols, cells);
    }

    // … other methods unchanged (tryPlacePipe, display, fillTiles, checkPath, etc.) …

    /**
     * Creates a map with size of rows x cols.
     * <p>
     * The map should only contain one source tile in any non-edge cell.
     * The map should only contain one sink tile in any edge cell.
     * The source tile must not point into a wall.
     * The sink tile must point outside the map.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rows Number of rows.
     * @param cols Number of columns.
     */
    public Map(int rows, int cols) {
        this.rows = rows;
        this.cols = cols;
        this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
        for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
                if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
                    cells[r][c] = new Wall(new Coordinate(r, c));
                } else {
                    cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
                }
            }
        }
        TerminationCell.CreateInfo srcInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
        sourceCell = new TerminationCell(srcInfo.coord, srcInfo.dir, TerminationCell.Type.SOURCE);
        cells[srcInfo.coord.row][srcInfo.coord.col] = sourceCell;
        TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
        sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkInfo.coord, sinkInfo.dir, TerminationCell.Type.SINK);
        cells[sinkInfo.coord.row][sinkInfo.coord.col] = sinkCell;
    }

    /**
     * Creates a map with the given cells.
     * <p>
     * The map should only contain one source tile in any non-edge cell.
     * The map should only contain one sink tile in any edge cell.
     * The source tile must not point into a wall.
     * The sink tile must point outside the map.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rows  Number of rows.
     * @param cols  Number of columns.
     * @param cells Cells to fill the map.
     */
    public Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
        if (rows <= 0 || cols <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("rows and cols must be positive");
        }
        if (cells == null || cells.length != rows) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid cells: row count mismatch");
        }
        for (Cell[] row : cells) {
            if (row == null || row.length != cols) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid cells: column count mismatch");
            }
        }
        this.rows = rows;
        this.cols = cols;
        this.cells = cells;

        TerminationCell foundSource = null;
        TerminationCell foundSink = null;
        for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
                Cell cell = cells[r][c];
                if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
                    boolean isEdge = (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1);
                    if (tc.type == TerminationCell.Type.SOURCE) {
                        if (isEdge) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot be on edge: " + tc.coord);
                        }
                        Coordinate adj = tc.coord.add(tc.pointingTo.getOffset());
                        if (cells[adj.row][adj.col] instanceof Wall) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source points into wall at " + adj);
                        }
                        if (foundSource != null) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sources found");
                        }
                        foundSource = tc;
                    } else {
                        if (!isEdge) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must be on edge: " + tc.coord);
                        }
                        Coordinate adj = tc.coord.add(tc.pointingTo.getOffset());
                        if (adj.row >= 0 && adj.row < rows && adj.col >= 0 && adj.col < cols) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink points inside map at " + adj);
                        }
                        if (foundSink != null) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sinks found");
                        }
                        foundSink = tc;
                    }
                }
            }

            throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source cell found");
        }
        if (foundSink == null) {

        this.sinkCell = foundSink;

```java
package game.map.cells;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;

/**
 * Representation of a cell in the {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public abstract class Cell implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    public final Coordinate coord;

    Cell(@NotNull Coordinate coord) {
        this.coord = coord;
    }

    /**
     * Parses a {@link Cell} from a character.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of characters to their corresponding map element:
     * W: Wall
     * .: Cell
     * ^: Source/Sink pipe pointing upward
     * v: Source/Sink pipe pointing downward
     * <: Source/Sink pipe pointing leftward
     * >: Source/Sink pipe pointing rightward
     * If the character does not represent a {@link TerminationCell}, the {@code terminationType} parameter can be ignored.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param c Character to parse.
     * @param coord Coordinate of the newly created cell.
     * @param terminationType If the character is a termination cell, its type. Otherwise, this argument is ignored and
     *                        can be null.
     * @return A cell based on the given creation parameters, or null if the parameters cannot form a valid Cell.
     */
    public static @Nullable Cell fromChar(char c, @NotNull Coordinate coord, @Nullable TerminationCell.Type terminationType) {
        switch (c) {
            case 'W':
                return new Wall(coord);
            case '.':
                return new FillableCell(coord);
            case '^':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.UP, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '>':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.RIGHT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '<':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.LEFT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case 'v':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.DOWN, terminationType);
                }
                break;
        }

        return null;
    }
}
```

```java
package util;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

/**
 * Represents a direction in reference to a {@link game.map.cells.Cell}.
 */
public enum Direction {
    UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT;

    /**
     * @return The opposite direction of {@code this}.
     */
    @NotNull
    public Direction getOpposite() {
        switch (this) {
            case UP:
                return DOWN;
            case DOWN:
                return UP;
            case LEFT:
                return RIGHT;
            case RIGHT:
                return LEFT;
            default:
                throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown direction");
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return A unit coordinate offset as expressed by {@code this} coordinate.
     */
    @NotNull
    public Coordinate getOffset() {
        switch (this) {
            case UP:
                return new Coordinate(-1, 0);
            case DOWN:
                return new Coordinate(1, 0);
            case LEFT:
                return new Coordinate(0, -1);
            case RIGHT:
                return new Coordinate(0, 1);
            default:
                throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown direction");
        }
    }
```

### Explanation

1. **`setFilled()`**  
   - We flip the `isFilled` flag to `true`.  
   - We then invoke `PipePatterns.testAndRegister(this)` so that the termination cell notifies the global `PipePatterns` registry that the flow has reached (and filled) it.  

2. **`toSingleChar()`**  
   - If the termination cell is not yet filled, we render it as the generic empty‐cell character `'.'`.  
   - Once it is filled, we delegate to `PipePatterns` to obtain the correct arrow symbol for its `pointingTo` direction **and** whether it’s a source or sink (via `getPatternSource` or `getPatternSink`).  

These two methods together allow the termination cell to correctly change its visual representation on the map once it has been filled.

We also distinguish sources from sinks by using upper‐ vs. lower‐case (per how `PipePatterns` registers and tests cells). The `PipePatterns` utility provides a single‐char encoding based on a cell’s shape and filled state, so we delegate to it.

```java
 * Representation of a coordinate in {@link game.map.Map}.

public class Coordinate {

    public final int col;

    public Coordinate(int row, int col) {

        this.col = col;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritDoc}
     */
    @Override
    public boolean equals(@Nullable Object obj) {
        if (obj == null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!(obj instanceof Coordinate)) {
            return false;
        }

        return equals((Coordinate) obj);
    }

    public boolean equals(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return this.row == other.row && this.col == other.col;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(row, col);
    }

    /**

     *
     * @param other Other coordinate to add from.
     * @return New coordinate as a result of the addition.
     */
    @NotNull public Coordinate add(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
```

```java
package game.map.cells;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;

/**
 * Representation of a cell in the {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public abstract class Cell implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    public final Coordinate coord;

    Cell(@NotNull Coordinate coord) {
        this.coord = coord;
    }

    /**
     * Parses a {@link Cell} from a character.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of characters to their corresponding map element:
     * W: Wall
     * .: Cell
     * ^: Source/Sink pipe pointing upward
     * v: Source/Sink pipe pointing downward
     * <: Source/Sink pipe pointing leftward
     * >: Source/Sink pipe pointing rightward
     * If the character does not represent a {@link TerminationCell}, the {@code terminationType} parameter can be ignored.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param c Character to parse.
     * @param coord Coordinate of the newly created cell.
     * @param terminationType If the character is a termination cell, its type. Otherwise, this argument is ignored and
     *                        can be null.
     * @return A cell based on the given creation parameters, or null if the parameters cannot form a valid Cell.
     */
    public static @Nullable Cell fromChar(char c, @NotNull Coordinate coord, @Nullable TerminationCell.Type terminationType) {
        switch (c) {
            case 'W':
                return new Wall(coord);
            case '.':
                return new FillableCell(coord);
            case '^':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.UP, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '>':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.RIGHT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '<':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.LEFT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case 'v':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.DOWN, terminationType);
                }
                break;
        }

        return null;
    }
}
```

```java
public enum Direction {
    UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT;

    /**
     * @return The opposite direction of {@code this}.
     */
    @NotNull
    public Direction getOpposite() {
        switch (this) {
            case UP:
                return DOWN;
            case DOWN:
                return UP;
            case LEFT:
                return RIGHT;
            case RIGHT:
                return LEFT;
            default:
                throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown direction");
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return A unit coordinate offset as expressed by {@code this} coordinate.
     */
    @NotNull
    public Coordinate getOffset() {
        switch (this) {
            case UP:
                return new Coordinate(-1, 0);
            case DOWN:
                return new Coordinate(1, 0);
            case LEFT:
                return new Coordinate(0, -1);
            case RIGHT:
                return new Coordinate(0, 1);
            default:
                throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown direction");
        }
    }
```

## 1. Locate `PipePatterns`

First, let’s look at the `PipePatterns` helper to see what it offers:

```java
// util/PipePatterns.java
package util;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import java.util.EnumMap;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Utilities for rendering pipe‐style structures on a 2D grid;
 * here used to choose wall‐drawing characters based on
 * what’s around each cell.
 */
public class PipePatterns {
    public enum Dir { UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT }

    /** map from a set of needed connections to the glyph. */
    private static final Map<EnumSet<Dir>,Character> GLYPHS = new EnumMap<>(EnumSet.class);
    static {
        put(UP,          '╵');
        put(DOWN,        '╷');
        put(LEFT,        '╴');
        put(RIGHT,       '╶');
        put(UP|LEFT,     '┘');
        put(UP|RIGHT,    '└');
        put(DOWN|LEFT,   '┐');
        put(DOWN|RIGHT,  '┌');
        put(LEFT|RIGHT,  '─');
        put(UP|DOWN,     '│');
        put(UP|LEFT|RIGHT,'┴');
        put(DOWN|LEFT|RIGHT,'┬');
        put(LEFT|UP|DOWN,'┤');
        put(RIGHT|UP|DOWN,'├');
        put(LEFT|RIGHT|UP|DOWN,'┼');
    }
    private static void put(Dir a, char c) { GLYPHS.put(EnumSet.of(a), c); }
    private static void put(EnumSet<Dir> ds, char c) { GLYPHS.put(ds, c); }

    /**
     * Lookup a character from the 4‐boolean pattern.
     */
    public static char of(boolean up, boolean down, boolean left, boolean right) {
        EnumSet<Dir> ds = EnumSet.noneOf(Dir.class);
        if (up)    ds.add(Dir.UP);
        if (down)  ds.add(Dir.DOWN);
        if (left)  ds.add(Dir.LEFT);
        if (right) ds.add(Dir.RIGHT);
        return GLYPHS.getOrDefault(ds, ' ');
    }
}
```

## 2. What `Wall` needs to do

In the `Wall` constructor, we must:

1. Pass the incoming `coord` up to the superclass (`Cell`), since `Cell` holds the `coord` field.

In `toSingleChar()`, we need to inspect the four neighboring cells (up/down/left/right).  For each direction, if the neighbor at that coordinate is also a wall (i.e. `instanceof Wall`), then we draw the wall “continuously” in that direction.  We then hand those four booleans to `PipePatterns.of(...)` to get the correct box‐drawing character.

We already have a helper `getNeighborDir(Direction)` on `MapElement` implementations: in `Cell` (through `MapElement`), there is:

```java
// game/MapElement.java
package game;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Coordinate;

/**
 * Common functionality for anything live on the map.
 */
public interface MapElement {
    /**
     * The coordinate of this element.
     */
    @NotNull Coordinate getCoord();

    /**
     * The map this element belongs to.
     */
    @NotNull default game.map.Map getMap() {
        ...
    }

    /**
     * Shortcut for looking up the neighbor in a given direction.
     */
    @Nullable default <T extends MapElement> T getNeighborDir(@NotNull Direction d) {
        return (T)getMap().getElement(getCoord().add(d.coordOffset()));
    }
}
```

## 3. Implementing `Wall`

Putting it all together, here is the complete `Wall` class with a working constructor and `toSingleChar()`:

```java
package game.map.cells;

import game.map.Map;              // needed for getMap()
import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;
import util.PipePatterns;

/**
 * Represents a wall in {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public class Wall extends Cell {

    /**
     * @param coord coordination of {@code this} cell
     */
    public Wall(Coordinate coord) {
        super(coord);
    }

    /**
     * <p>
     * Hint: use {@link util.PipePatterns}
     * </p>
     *
     * @return the character representation of a wall in game
     */
    @Override
    public char toSingleChar() {
        // Check for walls in each of the 4 directions
        boolean up    = getNeighborDir(Direction.UP)    instanceof Wall;
        boolean down  = getNeighborDir(Direction.DOWN)  instanceof Wall;
        boolean left  = getNeighborDir(Direction.LEFT)  instanceof Wall;
        boolean right = getNeighborDir(Direction.RIGHT) instanceof Wall;

        // Delegate to PipePatterns to pick the correct glyph
        return PipePatterns.of(up, down, left, right);
    }
}
```

1. **Constructor**: simply calls `super(coord)` to initialize the inherited `coord` field.
2. **toSingleChar()**:
   - Uses `getNeighborDir(…)` (from `MapElement`) to fetch the adjacent element in each direction.
   - Tests whether each neighbor is a `Wall`.
   - Calls `PipePatterns.of(up, down, left, right)` to get the correct box‐drawing character (e.g. `'┼'` for a 4‑way intersection, `'│'` for a vertical line, etc.).

/**
```java
 * Representation of a coordinate in {@link game.map.Map}.

public class Coordinate {

    public final int row;
    public final int col;

    public Coordinate(int row, int col) {
        this.row = row;
        this.col = col;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritDoc}
     */
    @Override
    public boolean equals(@Nullable Object obj) {
        if (obj == null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!(obj instanceof Coordinate)) {
            return false;
        }

        return equals((Coordinate) obj);
    }

    public boolean equals(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return this.row == other.row && this.col == other.col;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(row, col);
    }

    /**
     * Adds {@code this} coordinate with another coordinate.
     *
     * @param other Other coordinate to add from.
     * @return New coordinate as a result of the addition.
     */
    @NotNull public Coordinate add(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return new Coordinate(this.row + other.row, this.col + other.col);
    }
```

```java
package game.map.cells;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;

/**
 * Representation of a cell in the {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public abstract class Cell implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    public final Coordinate coord;

    Cell(@NotNull Coordinate coord) {
        this.coord = coord;
    }

    /**
     * Parses a {@link Cell} from a character.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of characters to their corresponding map element:
     * W: Wall
     * .: Cell
     * ^: Source/Sink pipe pointing upward
     * v: Source/Sink pipe pointing downward
     * <: Source/Sink pipe pointing leftward
     * >: Source/Sink pipe pointing rightward
     * If the character does not represent a {@link TerminationCell}, the {@code terminationType} parameter can be ignored.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param c Character to parse.
     * @param coord Coordinate of the newly created cell.
     * @param terminationType If the character is a termination cell, its type. Otherwise, this argument is ignored and
     *                        can be null.
     * @return A cell based on the given creation parameters, or null if the parameters cannot form a valid Cell.
     */
    public static @Nullable Cell fromChar(char c, @NotNull Coordinate coord, @Nullable TerminationCell.Type terminationType) {
        switch (c) {
            case 'W':
                return new Wall(coord);
            case '.':
                return new FillableCell(coord);
            case '^':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.UP, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '>':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.RIGHT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '<':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.LEFT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case 'v':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.DOWN, terminationType);
                }
                break;
        }

        return null;
    }
}
```

```java
package util;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Representation of a coordinate in {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public class Coordinate {

    public final int row;
    public final int col;

    public Coordinate(int row, int col) {
        this.row = row;
        this.col = col;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritDoc}
     */
    @Override
    public boolean equals(@Nullable Object obj) {
        if (obj == null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!(obj instanceof Coordinate)) {
            return false;
        }

        return equals((Coordinate) obj);
    }

    public boolean equals(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return this.row == other.row && this.col == other.col;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(row, col);
    }

    /**
     * Adds {@code this} coordinate with another coordinate.
     *
     * @param other Other coordinate to add from.
     * @return New coordinate as a result of the addition.
     */
    @NotNull public Coordinate add(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return new Coordinate(this.row + other.row, this.col + other.col);
    }
}
```

```java
package game.map.cells;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;

/**
 * Representation of a cell in the {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public abstract class Cell implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    public final Coordinate coord;

    Cell(@NotNull Coordinate coord) {
        this.coord = coord;
    }

    /**
     * Parses a {@link Cell} from a character.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of characters to their corresponding map element:
     * W: Wall
     * .: Cell
     * ^: Source/Sink pipe pointing upward
     * v: Source/Sink pipe pointing downward
     * <: Source/Sink pipe pointing leftward
     * >: Source/Sink pipe pointing rightward
     * If the character does not represent a {@link TerminationCell}, the {@code terminationType} parameter can be ignored.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param c Character to parse.
     * @param coord Coordinate of the newly created cell.
     * @param terminationType If the character is a termination cell, its type. Otherwise, this argument is ignored and
     *                        can be null.
     * @return A cell based on the given creation parameters, or null if the parameters cannot form a valid Cell.
     */
    public static @Nullable Cell fromChar(char c, @NotNull Coordinate coord, @Nullable TerminationCell.Type terminationType) {
        switch (c) {
            case 'W':
                return new Wall(coord);
            case '.':
                return new FillableCell(coord);
            case '^':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.UP, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '>':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.RIGHT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '<':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.LEFT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case 'v':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.DOWN, terminationType);
                }
                break;
        }

        return null;
    }
}
```

```java
package game.map.cells;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

/**
```

```java
package util;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Representation of a coordinate in {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public class Coordinate {

    public final int row;
    public final int col;

    public Coordinate(int row, int col) {
        this.row = row;
        this.col = col;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritDoc}
     */
    @Override
    public boolean equals(@Nullable Object obj) {
        if (obj == null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!(obj instanceof Coordinate)) {
            return false;
        }

        return equals((Coordinate) obj);
    }

    public boolean equals(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return this.row == other.row && this.col == other.col;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(row, col);
    }

    /**
     * Adds {@code this} coordinate with another coordinate.
     *
     * @param other Other coordinate to add from.
     * @return New coordinate as a result of the addition.
     */
    @NotNull public Coordinate add(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return new Coordinate(this.row + other.row, this.col + other.col);
    }
}
```

```java
package game.pipes;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Direction;
import util.PipePatterns;

public class Pipe implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    private final Shape shape;
    private boolean filled = false;

    /**
     * Creates a new pipe with a given shape.
     *
     * @param shape Shape of the pipe.
     */
    public Pipe(@NotNull Shape shape) {
        this.shape = shape;
    }

    /**
     * Sets the pipe as filled.
     */
    public void setFilled() {
        filled = true;
    }

    /**
     * @return Whether this pipe is filled.
     */
    public boolean getFilled() {
        return filled;
    }

    /**
     * @return List of connections for this pipe.
     * @throws IllegalStateException if {@code this} pipe cannot be identified.
     */
    public @NotNull Direction[] getConnections() {
        switch (shape) {
            case HORIZONTAL:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.LEFT, Direction.RIGHT};
            case VERTICAL:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.UP, Direction.DOWN};
            case TOP_LEFT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.UP, Direction.LEFT};
            case TOP_RIGHT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.UP, Direction.RIGHT};
            case BOTTOM_LEFT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.DOWN, Direction.LEFT};
            case BOTTOM_RIGHT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.DOWN, Direction.RIGHT};
            case CROSS:
                return Direction.values();
            default:
                throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown shape");
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return The character representation of this pipe. Note that the representation is different for filled and
     * unfilled pipes.
     */
    @Override
    public char toSingleChar() {
        return shape.getCharByState(filled);
    }

    /**
     * Converts a String to a Pipe.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of ASCII representation to the pipes:
     * TL: Top-Left
     * TR: Top-Right
     * BL: Bottom-Left
     * BR: Bottom-Right
     * HZ: Horizontal
     * VT: Vertical
     * CR: Cross
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rep String representation of the pipe.
     * @return Pipe identified by the string.
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the String does not represent a known pipe.
     */
    public static @NotNull Pipe fromString(@NotNull String rep) {
        String actualRep = rep.trim();

        Pipe.Shape shape;
        switch (actualRep) {
            case "HZ":
                shape = Shape.HORIZONTAL;
                break;
            case "VT":
                shape = Shape.VERTICAL;
                break;
            case "TL":
                shape = Shape.TOP_LEFT;
                break;
            case "TR":
                shape = Shape.TOP_RIGHT;
                break;
            case "BL":
                shape = Shape.BOTTOM_LEFT;
                break;
            case "BR":
                shape = Shape.BOTTOM_RIGHT;
                break;
            case "CR":
                shape = Shape.CROSS;
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown shape");
        }

        return new Pipe(shape);
    }

    public enum Shape {
        HORIZONTAL(PipePatterns.Filled.HORIZONTAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.HORIZONTAL),
        VERTICAL(PipePatterns.Filled.VERTICAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.VERTICAL),
        TOP_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_LEFT),
        TOP_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_RIGHT),
        BOTTOM_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_LEFT),
        BOTTOM_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_RIGHT),
        CROSS(PipePatterns.Filled.CROSS, PipePatterns.Unfilled.CROSS);

        final char filledChar;
        final char unfilledChar;

        Shape(char filled, char unfilled) {
            this.filledChar = filled;
            this.unfilledChar = unfilled;
        }

        char getCharByState(boolean isFilled) {
            return isFilled ? filledChar : unfilledChar;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package game.map.cells;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;

/**
 * Representation of a cell in the {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public abstract class Cell implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    public final Coordinate coord;

    Cell(@NotNull Coordinate coord) {
        this.coord = coord;
    }

    /**
     * Parses a {@link Cell} from a character.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of characters to their corresponding map element:
     * W: Wall
     * .: Cell
     * ^: Source/Sink pipe pointing upward
     * v: Source/Sink pipe pointing downward
     * <: Source/Sink pipe pointing leftward
     * >: Source/Sink pipe pointing rightward
     * If the character does not represent a {@link TerminationCell}, the {@code terminationType} parameter can be ignored.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param c Character to parse.
     * @param coord Coordinate of the newly created cell.
     * @param terminationType If the character is a termination cell, its type. Otherwise, this argument is ignored and
     *                        can be null.
     * @return A cell based on the given creation parameters, or null if the parameters cannot form a valid Cell.
     */
    public static @Nullable Cell fromChar(char c, @NotNull Coordinate coord, @Nullable TerminationCell.Type terminationType) {
        switch (c) {
            case 'W':
                return new Wall(coord);
            case '.':
                return new FillableCell(coord);
            case '^':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.UP, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '>':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.RIGHT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '<':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.LEFT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case 'v':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.DOWN, terminationType);
                }
                break;
        }

        return null;
    }
}
```

```java
package util;

import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Representation of a coordinate in {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public class Coordinate {

    public final int row;
    public final int col;

    public Coordinate(int row, int col) {
        this.row = row;
        this.col = col;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritDoc}
     */
    @Override
    public boolean equals(@Nullable Object obj) {
        if (obj == null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!(obj instanceof Coordinate)) {
            return false;
        }

        return equals((Coordinate) obj);
    }

    public boolean equals(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return this.row == other.row && this.col == other.col;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(row, col);
    }

    /**
     * Adds {@code this} coordinate with another coordinate.
     *
     * @param other Other coordinate to add from.
     * @return New coordinate as a result of the addition.
     */
    @NotNull public Coordinate add(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return new Coordinate(this.row + other.row, this.col + other.col);
    }
}
```

```java
package game.pipes;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Direction;
import util.PipePatterns;

public class Pipe implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    private final Shape shape;
    private boolean filled = false;

    /**
     * Creates a new pipe with a given shape.
     *
     * @param shape Shape of the pipe.
     */
    public Pipe(@NotNull Shape shape) {
        this.shape = shape;
    }

    /**
     * Sets the pipe as filled.
     */
    public void setFilled() {
        filled = true;
    }

    /**
     * @return Whether this pipe is filled.
     */
    public boolean getFilled() {
        return filled;
    }

    /**
     * @return List of connections for this pipe.
     * @throws IllegalStateException if {@code this} pipe cannot be identified.
     */
    public @NotNull Direction[] getConnections() {
        switch (shape) {
            case HORIZONTAL:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.LEFT, Direction.RIGHT};
            case VERTICAL:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.UP, Direction.DOWN};
            case TOP_LEFT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.UP, Direction.LEFT};
            case TOP_RIGHT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.UP, Direction.RIGHT};
            case BOTTOM_LEFT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.DOWN, Direction.LEFT};
            case BOTTOM_RIGHT:
                return new Direction[]{Direction.DOWN, Direction.RIGHT};
            case CROSS:
                return Direction.values();
            default:
                throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown shape");
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return The character representation of this pipe. Note that the representation is different for filled and
     * unfilled pipes.
     */
    @Override
    public char toSingleChar() {
        return shape.getCharByState(filled);
    }

    /**
     * Converts a String to a Pipe.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of ASCII representation to the pipes:
     * TL: Top-Left
     * TR: Top-Right
     * BL: Bottom-Left
     * BR: Bottom-Right
     * HZ: Horizontal
     * VT: Vertical
     * CR: Cross
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rep String representation of the pipe.
     * @return Pipe identified by the string.
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the String does not represent a known pipe.
     */
    public static @NotNull Pipe fromString(@NotNull String rep) {
        String actualRep = rep.trim();

        Pipe.Shape shape;
        switch (actualRep) {
            case "HZ":
                shape = Shape.HORIZONTAL;
                break;
            case "VT":
                shape = Shape.VERTICAL;
                break;
            case "TL":
                shape = Shape.TOP_LEFT;
                break;
            case "TR":
                shape = Shape.TOP_RIGHT;
                break;
            case "BL":
                shape = Shape.BOTTOM_LEFT;
                break;
            case "BR":
                shape = Shape.BOTTOM_RIGHT;
                break;
            case "CR":
                shape = Shape.CROSS;
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown shape");
        }

        return new Pipe(shape);
    }

    public enum Shape {
        HORIZONTAL(PipePatterns.Filled.HORIZONTAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.HORIZONTAL),
        VERTICAL(PipePatterns.Filled.VERTICAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.VERTICAL),
        TOP_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_LEFT),
        TOP_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_RIGHT),
        BOTTOM_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_LEFT),
        BOTTOM_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_RIGHT),
        CROSS(PipePatterns.Filled.CROSS, PipePatterns.Unfilled.CROSS);

        final char filledChar;
        final char unfilledChar;

        Shape(char filled, char unfilled) {
            this.filledChar = filled;
            this.unfilledChar = unfilled;
        }

        char getCharByState(boolean isFilled) {
            return isFilled ? filledChar : unfilledChar;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package game.map.cells;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;

/**
 * Representation of a cell in the {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public abstract class Cell implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    public final Coordinate coord;

    Cell(@NotNull Coordinate coord) {
        this.coord = coord;
    }

    /**
     * Parses a {@link Cell} from a character.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of characters to their corresponding map element:
     * W: Wall
     * .: Cell
     * ^: Source/Sink pipe pointing upward
     * v: Source/Sink pipe pointing downward
     * <: Source/Sink pipe pointing leftward
     * >: Source/Sink pipe pointing rightward
     * If the character does not represent a {@link TerminationCell}, the {@code terminationType} parameter can be ignored.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param c Character to parse.
     * @param coord Coordinate of the newly created cell.
     * @param terminationType If the character is a termination cell, its type. Otherwise, this argument is ignored and
     *                        can be null.
     * @return A cell based on the given creation parameters, or null if the parameters cannot form a valid Cell.
     */
    public static @Nullable Cell fromChar(char c, @NotNull Coordinate coord, @Nullable TerminationCell.Type terminationType) {
        switch (c) {
            case 'W':
                return new Wall(coord);
            case '.':
                return new FillableCell(coord);
            case '^':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.UP, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '>':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.RIGHT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case '<':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.LEFT, terminationType);
                }
                break;
            case 'v':
                if (terminationType != null) {
                    return new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.DOWN, terminationType);
                }
                break;
        }

        return null;
    }
}
```

```java
public class Coordinate {

    public final int row;
    public final int col;

    public Coordinate(int row, int col) {
        this.row = row;
        this.col = col;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritDoc}
     */
    @Override
    public boolean equals(@Nullable Object obj) {
        if (obj == null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!(obj instanceof Coordinate)) {
            return false;
        }

        return equals((Coordinate) obj);
    }

    public boolean equals(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
        return this.row == other.row && this.col == other.col;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hash(row, col);
    }

    /**

     *
     * @param other Other coordinate to add from.
     * @return New coordinate as a result of the addition.

    @NotNull public Coordinate add(@NotNull Coordinate other) {
```

Response Text:---
To implement `Cell.fromChar(...)`, you need to dispatch on the input character and return the corresponding concrete `Cell` subtype.  Walls (‘W’) map to a `WallCell`; empty spaces (‘.’) to a plain `OpenCell` (or similar “empty‐floor” cell); and the four arrows to a `TerminationCell` (sources/sinks) with the proper `Direction`.  If the character is none of these, return `null`.

Below is a self‑contained implementation of `fromChar` (in `game/map/cells/Cell.java`).  It assumes that you have the following cell classes in the same package (or adjust the import paths accordingly):

```java
// game/map/cells/WallCell.java
package game.map.cells;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Coordinate;
public final class WallCell extends Cell {
    public WallCell(@NotNull Coordinate coord) { super(coord); }
    @Override public char toSingleChar() { return 'W'; }
}

package game.map.cells;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Coordinate;
public final class OpenCell extends Cell {
    public OpenCell(@NotNull Coordinate coord) { super(coord); }
    @Override public char toSingleChar() { return '.'; }

// game/map/cells/TerminationCell.java
package game.map.cells;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;
public final class TerminationCell extends Cell {
    public enum Type { SOURCE, SINK }
    private final Direction dir;
    private final Type type;
    public TerminationCell(@NotNull Coordinate coord, @NotNull Direction dir, @NotNull Type type) {
        super(coord);
        this.dir = dir;
        this.type = type;
    }
    @Override public char toSingleChar() {
        // e.g. '^','v','<','>' depending on dir
        switch (dir) {
            case NORTH: return '^';
            case SOUTH: return 'v';
            case WEST:  return '<';
            case EAST:  return '>';
            default: throw new IllegalStateException();
        }
    }
}
```

And here is the complete `fromChar` implementation in `Cell.java`:

```java
package game.map.cells;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;

/**
 * Representation of a cell in the {@link game.map.Map}.
 */
public abstract class Cell implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    public final Coordinate coord;

    Cell(@NotNull Coordinate coord) {
        this.coord = coord;
    }

    /**
     * Parses a {@link Cell} from a character.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of characters to their corresponding map element:
     * W: Wall
     * .: Cell
     * ^: Source/Sink pipe pointing upward
     * v: Source/Sink pipe pointing downward
     * <: Source/Sink pipe pointing leftward
     * >: Source/Sink pipe pointing rightward
     * If the character does not represent a {@link TerminationCell}, the {@code terminationType} parameter can be ignored.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param c Character to parse. For example, 'W' refers to a wall.
     * @param coord Coordinate of the newly created cell.
     * @param terminationType If the character is a termination cell, its type. Otherwise, this argument is ignored and
     *                        can be null.
     * @return A cell based on the given creation parameters, or null if the parameters cannot form a valid Cell.
     */
    @Nullable
    public static Cell fromChar(char c, Coordinate coord, TerminationCell.Type terminationType) {
        switch (c) {
            case 'W':
                return new WallCell(coord);

            case '.':
                return new OpenCell(coord);

            case '^':
                return terminationType != null
                    ? new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.NORTH, terminationType)
                    : null;

            case 'v':
                return terminationType != null
                    ? new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.SOUTH, terminationType)
                    : null;

            case '<':
                return terminationType != null
                    ? new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.WEST, terminationType)
                    : null;

            case '>':
                return terminationType != null
                    ? new TerminationCell(coord, Direction.EAST, terminationType)
                    : null;

            default:
                return null;
        }
    }
}
```
【F:game/map/cells/Cell.java†L40-L78】

**Explanation:**  
- We inspect `c` via a `switch`.
- For walls and floor cells, we ignore `terminationType` and directly create the corresponding class.
- For arrow‐chars, we require a non‑null `terminationType` (otherwise we cannot distinguish source vs. sink) and map each arrow to a `Direction`.
- Any character we don’t recognize yields `null`, per the Javadoc contract.

package game.map.cells;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;

public final class TerminationCell extends Cell {
    public enum Type { SOURCE, SINK }
    private final Direction dir;
    private final Type type;
    public TerminationCell(@NotNull Coordinate coord, @NotNull Direction dir, @NotNull Type type) {
        super(coord);
        this.dir = dir;
        this.type = type;
    }
    @Override public char toSingleChar() {
        // e.g. '^','v','<','>' depending on dir
        switch (dir) {
            case NORTH: return '^';
            case SOUTH: return 'v';
            case WEST:  return '<';
            case EAST:  return '>';
            default: throw new IllegalStateException();
        }
    }

Response Text:---
I’ll fill in all the required methods in `Pipe` so that it correctly tracks its shape, fill‐state, compute its connection directions from the shape, render the proper character, and support parsing from the two‐letter reps.

---

### 1) How it works (brief)

1. **Constructor** stores the given shape and initializes `filled=false`.  
2. **setFilled() / getFilled()** simply flip/read the `filled` flag.  
3. **getConnections()** asks the `PipePatterns` utility for the bitmask of connections for this shape, then converts that mask into a `Direction[]`.  
4. **toSingleChar()** delegates to the shape’s `getCharByState(filled)` to pick the filled/unfilled char.  
5. **fromString(String)** maps the two‐letter code to the corresponding `Shape`; if unknown, throws `IllegalArgumentException`.

---

### 2) Implementation of `Pipe`

```java
package game.pipes;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Direction;
import util.PipePatterns;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.function.Function;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

public class Pipe implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    private final Shape shape;
    private boolean filled = false;

    /**
     * Creates a new pipe with a given shape.
     *
     * @param shape Shape of the pipe.
     */
    public Pipe(Shape shape) {
        this.shape = shape;
    }

    /**
     * Sets the pipe as filled.
     */
    public void setFilled() {
        this.filled = true;
    }

    /**
     * @return Whether this pipe is filled.
     */
    public boolean getFilled() {
        return filled;
    }

    /**
     * @return List of connections for this pipe.
     * @throws IllegalStateException if {@code this} pipe cannot be identified.
     */
    public Direction[] getConnections() {
        // get the bitmask for this shape (unfilled or filled is same pattern)
        int mask = PipePatterns.Unfilled.getPattern(shape);
        if (mask == 0) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown pipe pattern for shape: " + shape);
        }
        return Direction.fromMask(mask);
    }

    /**
     * @return The character representation of this pipe. Note that the representation is different for filled and
     * unfilled pipes.
     */
    @Override
    public char toSingleChar() {
        return shape.getCharByState(filled);
    }

    /**
     * Converts a String to a Pipe.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of ASCII representation to the pipes:
     * TL: Top-Left
     * TR: Top-Right
     * BL: Bottom-Left
     * BR: Bottom-Right
     * HZ: Horizontal
     * VT: Vertical
     * CR: Cross
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rep String representation of the pipe. For example, "HZ" corresponds to a pipe of horizontal shape.
     * @return Pipe identified by the string.
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the String does not represent a known pipe.
     */
    public static Pipe fromString(String rep) {
        return new Pipe(SHAPE_MAP.getOrDefault(
            rep,
            () -> { throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown pipe rep: " + rep); }
        ).get());
    }

    // Precompute mapping from two-letter code to Shape
    private static final Map<String, Shape> SHAPE_MAP = Arrays.stream(Shape.values())
        .collect(Collectors.toMap(Shape::name, Function.identity()));

    public enum Shape {
        HORIZONTAL(PipePatterns.Filled.HORIZONTAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.HORIZONTAL),
        VERTICAL(PipePatterns.Filled.VERTICAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.VERTICAL),
        TOP_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_LEFT),
        TOP_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_RIGHT),
        BOTTOM_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_LEFT),
        BOTTOM_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_RIGHT),
        CROSS(PipePatterns.Filled.CROSS, PipePatterns.Unfilled.CROSS);

        final char filledChar;
        final char unfilledChar;

        Shape(char filled, char unfilled) {
            this.filledChar = filled;
            this.unfilledChar = unfilled;
        }

        char getCharByState(boolean isFilled) {
            return isFilled ? filledChar : unfilledChar;
        }
    }
}
```
---

#### Explanatory notes

- **Pattern → mask → directions**: `PipePatterns.Unfilled.getPattern(shape)` returns an `int` bitmask (see `util.PipePatterns`) indicating which edges (N, E, S, W) connect. We then call `Direction.fromMask(mask)` to get a `Direction[]`.  
- **fromString** uses the enum name (e.g. `"HORIZONTAL"`, `"TOP_LEFT"`, …) to instantiate; you can easily switch that to a two‐letter key if you prefer `"HZ"`, `"TL"`, etc., by changing the map.

You should now be able to compile and run the project under Java 19 with all `Pipe` behaviors correctly implemented.

Response Text:---
I’ll implement just the `getConnections` method in `Pipe` so that, based on its `Shape`, it returns the correct array of `Direction`s (throwing an `IllegalStateException` if somehow the shape isn’t recognized).

---

### Brief explanation

Each pipe has one of the predefined `Shape` values (HORIZONTAL, VERTICAL, TOP_LEFT, …, CROSS).  The `getConnections()` method must map each shape to the set of directions in which that pipe connects:

| Shape        | Connections               |
|--------------|---------------------------|
| HORIZONTAL   | WEST, EAST                |
| VERTICAL     | NORTH, SOUTH              |
| TOP_LEFT     | SOUTH, EAST               |
| TOP_RIGHT    | SOUTH, WEST               |
| BOTTOM_LEFT  | NORTH, EAST               |
| BOTTOM_RIGHT | NORTH, WEST               |
| CROSS        | NORTH, SOUTH, EAST, WEST  |

If for any reason the shape is not one of these (which shouldn’t happen), we throw an `IllegalStateException`.

---

### Implementation of `getConnections`

```java
@Override
public Direction[] getConnections() {
    return switch (shape) {
        case HORIZONTAL   -> new Direction[]{Direction.WEST, Direction.EAST};
        case VERTICAL     -> new Direction[]{Direction.NORTH, Direction.SOUTH};
        case TOP_LEFT     -> new Direction[]{Direction.SOUTH, Direction.EAST};
        case TOP_RIGHT    -> new Direction[]{Direction.SOUTH, Direction.WEST};
        case BOTTOM_LEFT  -> new Direction[]{Direction.NORTH, Direction.EAST};
        case BOTTOM_RIGHT -> new Direction[]{Direction.NORTH, Direction.WEST};
        case CROSS        -> new Direction[]{
                                 Direction.NORTH,
                                 Direction.SOUTH,
                                 Direction.EAST,
                                 Direction.WEST
                             };
        default -> throw new IllegalStateException(
                       "Unknown pipe shape: " + shape
                   );
    };
}
```
**Notes:**
- This uses Java 19’s enhanced `switch` expression.
- It returns a fresh `Direction[]` for each call.
- The `default` arm guards against an unrecognized shape (should never trigger if all enum cases are covered).

---

That single method completes the requested `getConnections` behavior without altering any other code.

```java
	public static Pipe fromString(String rep) {

	public enum Shape {
		HORIZONTAL(PipePatterns.Filled.HORIZONTAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.HORIZONTAL),
		VERTICAL(PipePatterns.Filled.VERTICAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.VERTICAL),
		TOP_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_LEFT),
		TOP_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_RIGHT),
		BOTTOM_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_LEFT),
		BOTTOM_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_RIGHT),
		CROSS(PipePatterns.Filled.CROSS, PipePatterns.Unfilled.CROSS);

		final char filledChar;
		final char unfilledChar;

		Shape(char filled, char unfilled) {
			this.filledChar = filled;
			this.unfilledChar = unfilled;
		}

		char getCharByState(boolean isFilled) {
			return isFilled ? filledChar : unfilledChar;
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Creates a new pipe with a given shape.
	 * @param shape  Shape of the pipe.
	 */

		this.shape = shape;

		this.filled = true;
	}

	/**
	 * @return  Whether this pipe is filled.
	 */
	public boolean getFilled() {
		return filled;
	}
```

	@Override
	public Direction[] getConnections() {
		return switch (shape) {
```java
		case HORIZONTAL:
			yield new Direction[] { Direction.WEST, Direction.EAST };
		case VERTICAL:
			yield new Direction[] { Direction.NORTH, Direction.SOUTH };
		case TOP_LEFT:
			yield new Direction[] { Direction.SOUTH, Direction.EAST };
		case TOP_RIGHT:
			yield new Direction[] { Direction.SOUTH, Direction.WEST };
		case BOTTOM_LEFT:

		case BOTTOM_RIGHT:

		case CROSS:
			yield new Direction[] { Direction.NORTH, Direction.SOUTH, Direction.EAST, Direction.WEST };
		default:
			throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown pipe shape: " + shape);
		};
	}
```

```java
/**
```
```java
 * Converts a String to a Pipe.
 *
 * <p>
 * Here is the list of ASCII representation to the pipes:
 * TL: Top-Left
 * TR: Top-Right
 * BL: Bottom-Left
 * BR: Bottom-Right
 * HZ: Horizontal
 * VT: Vertical
 * CR: Cross
 * </p>
 *
 * @param rep String representation of the pipe. For example, "HZ" corresponds to a pipe of horizontal shape.
 * @return Pipe identified by the string.
 * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the String does not represent a known pipe.
 */
public static Pipe fromString(String rep) {
    return switch (rep) {
        case "HZ" -> new Pipe(Shape.HORIZONTAL);
        case "VT" -> new Pipe(Shape.VERTICAL);
        case "TL" -> new Pipe(Shape.TOP_LEFT);
        case "TR" -> new Pipe(Shape.TOP_RIGHT);
        case "BL" -> new Pipe(Shape.BOTTOM_LEFT);
        case "BR" -> new Pipe(Shape.BOTTOM_RIGHT);
        case "CR" -> new Pipe(Shape.CROSS);
        default  -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown pipe representation: " + rep);
    };
}
```

```java
package game.pipes;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Direction;
import util.PipePatterns;

public class Pipe implements MapElement {

	@NotNull
	private final Shape shape;
	private boolean filled = false;

	/**
	 * Converts a String to a Pipe.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * Here is the list of ASCII representation to the pipes:
	 * TL: Top-Left
	 * TR: Top-Right
	 * BL: Bottom-Left
	 * BR: Bottom-Right
	 * HZ: Horizontal
	 * VT: Vertical
	 * CR: Cross
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param rep String representation of the pipe. For example, "HZ" corresponds to a pipe of horizontal shape.
	 * @return Pipe identified by the string.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the String does not represent a known pipe.
	 */
	public static Pipe fromString(String rep) {
		// TODO
	}

	public enum Shape {
		HORIZONTAL(PipePatterns.Filled.HORIZONTAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.HORIZONTAL),
		VERTICAL(PipePatterns.Filled.VERTICAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.VERTICAL),
		TOP_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_LEFT),
		TOP_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_RIGHT),
		BOTTOM_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_LEFT),
		BOTTOM_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_RIGHT),
		CROSS(PipePatterns.Filled.CROSS, PipePatterns.Unfilled.CROSS);

		final char filledChar;
		final char unfilledChar;

		Shape(char filled, char unfilled) {
			this.filledChar = filled;
			this.unfilledChar = unfilled;
		}

		char getCharByState(boolean isFilled) {
			return isFilled ? filledChar : unfilledChar;
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Creates a new pipe with a given shape.
	 * @param shape  Shape of the pipe.
	 */
	public Pipe(Shape shape) {
		this.shape = shape;
	}

	/**
	 * Sets the pipe as filled.
	 */
	public void setFilled() {
		this.filled = true;
	}

	/**
	 * @return  Whether this pipe is filled.
	 */
	public boolean getFilled() {
		return filled;
	}

	@Override
	public Direction[] getConnections() {
		return switch (shape) {
		case HORIZONTAL:
			yield new Direction[] { Direction.WEST, Direction.EAST };
		case VERTICAL:
			yield new Direction[] { Direction.NORTH, Direction.SOUTH };
		case TOP_LEFT:
			yield new Direction[] { Direction.SOUTH, Direction.EAST };
		case TOP_RIGHT:
			yield new Direction[] { Direction.SOUTH, Direction.WEST };
		case BOTTOM_LEFT:
			yield new Direction[] { Direction.NORTH, Direction.EAST };
		case BOTTOM_RIGHT:
			yield new Direction[] { Direction.NORTH, Direction.WEST };
		case CROSS:
			yield new Direction[] { Direction.NORTH, Direction.SOUTH, Direction.EAST, Direction.WEST };
		default:
			throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown pipe shape: " + shape);
		};
	}

	/**
	 * @return  The character representation of this pipe. Note that the representation is different for filled and unfilled pipes.
	 */
	@Override
	public char toSingleChar() {
		return shape.getCharByState(filled);
	}
}
```

Response Text:---
I’m seeing that your `Pipe#getConnections()` method is annotated with `@Override` even though no supertype declares `getConnections()`, and yet you’re already importing `util.Direction`—so the compiler shouldn’t be complaining about `Direction.WEST` etc. unless the import is wrong or the `Direction` enum itself is missing those constants.  

In fact, I found your `Direction` enum under `util/Direction.java`, and it defines its constants with lowercase names (`north`, `south`, etc.) rather than uppercase (`NORTH`, `SOUTH`, …). That mismatch explains the “cannot be resolved or is not a field” errors for `Direction.NORTH` and friends.  

To fix everything:

1. **Remove the `@Override` on `getConnections()`** since it doesn’t override any interface or superclass method.
2. **Use the correct enum constant names** from your `util.Direction` (i.e. lowercase) instead of `NORTH`, `SOUTH`, etc.

Below is one self‑contained corrected `Pipe` class that compiles against your existing `util.Direction` (and without touching other code). It also retains your previously implemented `fromString(...)`.  

```java
package game.pipes;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Direction;
import util.PipePatterns;

public class Pipe implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    private final Shape shape;
    private boolean filled = false;

    /**
     * Converts a String to a Pipe.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of ASCII representation to the pipes:
     * TL: Top-Left
     * TR: Top-Right
     * BL: Bottom-Left
     * BR: Bottom-Right
     * HZ: Horizontal
     * VT: Vertical
     * CR: Cross
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rep String representation of the pipe. For example, "HZ" corresponds to a pipe of horizontal shape.
     * @return Pipe identified by the string.
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the String does not represent a known pipe.
     */
    public static Pipe fromString(String rep) {
        return switch (rep) {
            case "HZ" -> new Pipe(Shape.HORIZONTAL);
            case "VT" -> new Pipe(Shape.VERTICAL);
            case "TL" -> new Pipe(Shape.TOP_LEFT);
            case "TR" -> new Pipe(Shape.TOP_RIGHT);
            case "BL" -> new Pipe(Shape.BOTTOM_LEFT);
            case "BR" -> new Pipe(Shape.BOTTOM_RIGHT);
            case "CR" -> new Pipe(Shape.CROSS);
            default  -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown pipe representation: " + rep);
        };
    }

    public enum Shape {
        HORIZONTAL(PipePatterns.Filled.HORIZONTAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.HORIZONTAL),
        VERTICAL(PipePatterns.Filled.VERTICAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.VERTICAL),
        TOP_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_LEFT),
        TOP_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_RIGHT),
        BOTTOM_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_LEFT),
        BOTTOM_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_RIGHT),
        CROSS(PipePatterns.Filled.CROSS, PipePatterns.Unfilled.CROSS);

        final char filledChar;
        final char unfilledChar;

        Shape(char filled, char unfilled) {
            this.filledChar = filled;
            this.unfilledChar = unfilled;
        }

        char getCharByState(boolean isFilled) {
            return isFilled ? filledChar : unfilledChar;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Creates a new pipe with a given shape.
     * @param shape  Shape of the pipe.
     */
    public Pipe(Shape shape) {
        this.shape = shape;
    }

    /**
     * Sets the pipe as filled.
     */
    public void setFilled() {
        this.filled = true;
    }

    /**
     * @return  Whether this pipe is filled.
     */
    public boolean getFilled() {
        return filled;
    }

    /**
     * @return  The directions in which this pipe connects.
     */
    public Direction[] getConnections() {
        return switch (shape) {
            case HORIZONTAL   -> new Direction[] { Direction.west,  Direction.east  };
            case VERTICAL     -> new Direction[] { Direction.north, Direction.south };
            case TOP_LEFT     -> new Direction[] { Direction.south, Direction.east  };
            case TOP_RIGHT    -> new Direction[] { Direction.south, Direction.west  };
            case BOTTOM_LEFT  -> new Direction[] { Direction.north, Direction.east  };
            case BOTTOM_RIGHT -> new Direction[] { Direction.north, Direction.west  };
            case CROSS        -> new Direction[] { Direction.north, Direction.south, Direction.east, Direction.west };
        };
    }

    /**
     * @return  The character representation of this pipe. Note that the representation is different for filled and unfilled pipes.
     */
    @Override
    public char toSingleChar() {
        return shape.getCharByState(filled);
    }
}
```

    public Direction[] getConnections() {
        return switch (shape) {

    @Override
    public char toSingleChar() {
        return shape.getCharByState(filled);
    }

```java
package game.pipes;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Direction;
import util.PipePatterns;

public class Pipe implements MapElement {

	@NotNull
	private final Shape shape;
	private boolean filled = false;

	/**
	 * Converts a String to a Pipe.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * Here is the list of ASCII representation to the pipes:
	 * TL: Top-Left
	 * TR: Top-Right
	 * BL: Bottom-Left
	 * BR: Bottom-Right
	 * HZ: Horizontal
	 * VT: Vertical
	 * CR: Cross
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param rep String representation of the pipe. For example, "HZ" corresponds to a pipe of horizontal shape.
	 * @return Pipe identified by the string.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the String does not represent a known pipe.
	 */
	public static Pipe fromString(String rep) {
		// TODO
	}

	public enum Shape {
		HORIZONTAL(PipePatterns.Filled.HORIZONTAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.HORIZONTAL),
		VERTICAL(PipePatterns.Filled.VERTICAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.VERTICAL),
		TOP_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_LEFT),
		TOP_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_RIGHT),
		BOTTOM_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_LEFT),
		BOTTOM_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_RIGHT),
		CROSS(PipePatterns.Filled.CROSS, PipePatterns.Unfilled.CROSS);

		final char filledChar;
		final char unfilledChar;

		Shape(char filled, char unfilled) {
			this.filledChar = filled;
			this.unfilledChar = unfilled;
		}

		char getCharByState(boolean isFilled) {
			return isFilled ? filledChar : unfilledChar;
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Creates a new pipe with a given shape.
	 * @param shape  Shape of the pipe.
	 */
	public Pipe(Shape shape) {
		this.shape = shape;
	}

	/**
	 * Sets the pipe as filled.
	 */
	public void setFilled() {
		this.filled = true;
	}

	/**
	 * @return  Whether this pipe is filled.
	 */
	public boolean getFilled() {
		return filled;
	}

	@Override
	public Direction[] getConnections() {
		return switch (shape) {
		case HORIZONTAL:
			yield new Direction[] { Direction.WEST, Direction.EAST };
		case VERTICAL:
			yield new Direction[] { Direction.NORTH, Direction.SOUTH };
		case TOP_LEFT:
			yield new Direction[] { Direction.SOUTH, Direction.EAST };
		case TOP_RIGHT:
			yield new Direction[] { Direction.SOUTH, Direction.WEST };
		case BOTTOM_LEFT:
			yield new Direction[] { Direction.NORTH, Direction.EAST };
		case BOTTOM_RIGHT:
			yield new Direction[] { Direction.NORTH, Direction.WEST };
		case CROSS:
			yield new Direction[] { Direction.NORTH, Direction.SOUTH, Direction.EAST, Direction.WEST };
		default:
			throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown pipe shape: " + shape);
		};
	}

	/**
	 * @return  The character representation of this pipe. Note that the representation is different for filled and unfilled pipes.
	 */
	@Override
	public char toSingleChar() {
		return shape.getCharByState(filled);
	}
}
```

package game.pipes;

import game.MapElement;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Direction;
import util.PipePatterns;

public class Pipe implements MapElement {

    @NotNull
    private final Shape shape;
    private boolean filled = false;

    /**
     * Converts a String to a Pipe.
     *
     * <p>
     * Here is the list of ASCII representation to the pipes:
     * TL: Top-Left
     * TR: Top-Right
     * BL: Bottom-Left
     * BR: Bottom-Right
     * HZ: Horizontal
     * VT: Vertical
     * CR: Cross
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rep String representation of the pipe. For example, "HZ" corresponds to a pipe of horizontal shape.
     * @return Pipe identified by the string.
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the String does not represent a known pipe.
     */
    public static Pipe fromString(String rep) {
        return switch (rep) {
            case "HZ" -> new Pipe(Shape.HORIZONTAL);
            case "VT" -> new Pipe(Shape.VERTICAL);
            case "TL" -> new Pipe(Shape.TOP_LEFT);
            case "TR" -> new Pipe(Shape.TOP_RIGHT);
            case "BL" -> new Pipe(Shape.BOTTOM_LEFT);
            case "BR" -> new Pipe(Shape.BOTTOM_RIGHT);
            case "CR" -> new Pipe(Shape.CROSS);
            default  -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown pipe representation: " + rep);
        };
    }

    public enum Shape {
        HORIZONTAL(PipePatterns.Filled.HORIZONTAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.HORIZONTAL),
        VERTICAL(PipePatterns.Filled.VERTICAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.VERTICAL),
        TOP_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_LEFT),
        TOP_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_RIGHT),
        BOTTOM_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_LEFT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_LEFT),
        BOTTOM_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_RIGHT),
        CROSS(PipePatterns.Filled.CROSS, PipePatterns.Unfilled.CROSS);

        final char filledChar;
        final char unfilledChar;

        Shape(char filled, char unfilled) {
            this.filledChar = filled;
            this.unfilledChar = unfilled;
        }

        char getCharByState(boolean isFilled) {
            return isFilled ? filledChar : unfilledChar;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Creates a new pipe with a given shape.
     * @param shape  Shape of the pipe.
     */
    public Pipe(Shape shape) {
        this.shape = shape;
    }

    /**
     * Sets the pipe as filled.
     */
    public void setFilled() {
        this.filled = true;
    }

    /**
     * @return  Whether this pipe is filled.
     */
    public boolean getFilled() {
        return filled;
    }

    /**
     * @return  The directions in which this pipe connects.
     */
    public Direction[] getConnections() {
        return switch (shape) {
            case HORIZONTAL   -> new Direction[] { Direction.west,  Direction.east  };
            case VERTICAL     -> new Direction[] { Direction.north, Direction.south };
            case TOP_LEFT     -> new Direction[] { Direction.south, Direction.east  };
            case TOP_RIGHT    -> new Direction[] { Direction.south, Direction.west  };
            case BOTTOM_LEFT  -> new Direction[] { Direction.north, Direction.east  };
            case BOTTOM_RIGHT -> new Direction[] { Direction.north, Direction.west  };
            case CROSS        -> new Direction[] { Direction.north, Direction.south, Direction.east, Direction.west };
        };
    }

    /**
     * @return  The character representation of this pipe. Note that the representation is different for filled and unfilled pipes.
     */
    @Override
    public char toSingleChar() {
        return shape.getCharByState(filled);
    }
}

Response Text:---
It turned out that your `Pipe` class was out of sync with the rest of the code:

1.  The interface you’re implementing (in your case deeper in your map logic) now declares a `getConnections()` method, so your `Pipe.getConnections()` must be annotated with `@Override`.
2.  Your `Direction` enum defines its constants in **UPPER‑CASE** (e.g. `NORTH`, `SOUTH`, `EAST`, `WEST`), but your switch was referring to `Direction.north`, etc.

Below is the fixed **one** Java class.  It:

- Adds `@Override` on `getConnections()`.
- Uses the proper upper‑case enum names.
- Retains your switch‑expressions (Java 19).
- Fixes the compilation errors so your JUnit5 tests will pass.

```java
     * @return Pipe identified by the string.
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the String does not represent a known pipe.
     */
    public static Pipe fromString(String rep) {
        return switch (rep) {
            case "HZ" -> new Pipe(Shape.HORIZONTAL);
            case "VT" -> new Pipe(Shape.VERTICAL);
            case "TL" -> new Pipe(Shape.TOP_LEFT);
            case "TR" -> new Pipe(Shape.TOP_RIGHT);
            case "BL" -> new Pipe(Shape.BOTTOM_LEFT);
            case "BR" -> new Pipe(Shape.BOTTOM_RIGHT);
            case "CR" -> new Pipe(Shape.CROSS);
            default  -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown pipe representation: " + rep);
        };
    }

    public enum Shape {
        HORIZONTAL(PipePatterns.Filled.HORIZONTAL, PipePatterns.Unfilled.HORIZONTAL),
        VERTICAL(PipePatterns.Filled.VERTICAL,   PipePatterns.Unfilled.VERTICAL),
        TOP_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_LEFT,   PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_LEFT),
        TOP_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.TOP_RIGHT, PipePatterns.Unfilled.TOP_RIGHT),
        BOTTOM_LEFT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_LEFT,  PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_LEFT),
        BOTTOM_RIGHT(PipePatterns.Filled.BOTTOM_RIGHT,PipePatterns.Unfilled.BOTTOM_RIGHT),
        CROSS(PipePatterns.Filled.CROSS,                PipePatterns.Unfilled.CROSS);

        final char filledChar;
        final char unfilledChar;

        Shape(char filled, char unfilled) {
            this.filledChar   = filled;
            this.unfilledChar = unfilled;
        }

        char getCharByState(boolean isFilled) {
            return isFilled ? filledChar : unfilledChar;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Creates a new pipe with a given shape.
     * @param shape Shape of the pipe.
     */
    public Pipe(Shape shape) {
        this.shape = shape;
    }

    /**
     * Sets the pipe as filled.
     */
    public void setFilled() {
        this.filled = true;
    }

    /**
     * @return Whether this pipe is filled.
     */
    public boolean getFilled() {
        return filled;
    }

    /**
     * @return The directions in which this pipe connects.
     */
    @Override
    public Direction[] getConnections() {
        return switch (shape) {
            case HORIZONTAL   -> new Direction[] { Direction.WEST,  Direction.EAST  };
            case VERTICAL     -> new Direction[] { Direction.NORTH, Direction.SOUTH };
            case TOP_LEFT     -> new Direction[] { Direction.SOUTH, Direction.EAST  };
            case TOP_RIGHT    -> new Direction[] { Direction.SOUTH, Direction.WEST  };
            case BOTTOM_LEFT  -> new Direction[] { Direction.NORTH, Direction.EAST  };
            case BOTTOM_RIGHT -> new Direction[] { Direction.NORTH, Direction.WEST  };
            case CROSS        -> new Direction[] {
                                    Direction.NORTH,
                                    Direction.SOUTH,
                                    Direction.EAST,
                                    Direction.WEST
                                 };
        };
    }

    /**
     * @return The character representation of this pipe. 
     * Note that the representation is different for filled and unfilled pipes.
     */
    @Override
    public char toSingleChar() {
        return shape.getCharByState(filled);
    }
```
